action.objective: Complete broad depth-3 coverage over all four legal root moves to identify the safest and strongest candidate under the check.
action.rationale: White is in check with only four legal moves: c2f2, g1f1, g1g2, g1h1. None of the previously analyzed move's continuation is legal now (Black played e5d4). Broad search is required before any commit; reserve nodes for verifying a single selected candidate.
